design: prospective descriptive reference comparison, not accuracy validation
known_prior_exposure: Existing preliminary UN mudflow/rockflow mapping and NASA GLC were viewed in earlier implementations; those cannot be called blinded references.
Existing radar observations, NASADEM and Phase 3 control diagnostics are known. No new OPERA/HLS reference catalog or image has been examined.
spatial_use: No buffer is applied to measured intersection area; tolerance is disclosed for geolocation differences. Pixel-center inclusion for reference cells.
sensor_difference: NISAR L-band vs Sentinel-1 C-band or HLS optical; different scattering/cloud sensitivity.
matching: Choose closest eligible reference in tolerance, then lowest cloud where available, then lexicographic ID, without inspecting response values.
holdout_policy: No reference value can select thresholds, tune rules, pick footprints, or change input baselines. Negative/mixed results retained.
limitations: No random/exhaustive truth sample or validated stable/unmapped labels; descriptive overlap only.
